## Type of change

- [ ] New skill
- [ ] Improvement to an existing skill
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tooling or project setup

## How did you test it?

<!-- Which agent and model did you use? What did you ask? What happened? Do not claim results you did not measure. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Original work: I wrote this myself, or it is MIT-compatible with attribution kept. I did not copy from other skill repositories, libraries or websites.
- [ ] Skill folder name starts with `vyson-` and matches `name` in `SKILL.md`.
- [ ] `SKILL.md` is under 500 lines and the description says what it does and when to use it.
- [ ] I added an example in `examples/` and an eval file in `evals/` (including a case where the skill should not activate).
- [ ] Any library I recommend is listed in `THIRD_PARTY.md` with its license, checked from an official source.
- [ ] No instructions are fetched from the internet at run time.
- [ ] Motion or 3D skills state a performance budget, reduced-motion behavior and a mobile fallback.
- [ ] Every asset in an example has its license recorded.
